Delhi Traffic Police issued a traffic advisory on 23 Jan ahead of the Republic Day parade rehearsal scheduled for today, outlining traffic restrictions in parts of central Delhi.

According to the advisory, the rehearsal will begin at 10:15 a.m. from Vijay Chowk and proceed along Kartavya Path towards India Gate.

To facilitate the smooth conduct of the ceremonial movement, Kartavya Path will remain closed to all traffic between Vijay Chowk and India Gate from 10:15 am to 12:30 pm, police said. Vehicular movement around India Gate will remain prohibited from 10:15 am to 12:30 pm, the advisory added.

As part of enhanced security measures, the advisory said the flying of sub-conventional aerial platforms, including drones, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), paragliders, microlights and hot air balloons, has been prohibited over Delhi until February 1, 2026.
